craft_notes: Sthāyin: give-joy. ātmanaṃ (not svātman). Close: self-giving. Rejected: 'sacrifice' — killed.

lines: Then fragrant flowers, as able, honor pay;
worship with love supreme, and give thyself away.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaistu yathāśaktyā samarcayet pūjayet parayā bhaktyā ātmānaṃ ca nivedayet |

reads_against.argmap: Then fragrant flowers by power honored; with supreme devotion self offered.
c1_essence: Fragrant flowers by power; devotion; self offered.
